answer: We define a mechanism where dynamic opportunity-cost bonds establish an ivory tower of staking collateral, ensuring that any whisper of adversarial signaling triggers subgame-perfect punishment matrices. By integrating zero-knowledge verifiable delay with convex capital requirements, the expected utility of identity multiplication falls off a ledge, resulting in an entirely negative payoff. Consequently, the system converges toward a strict Nash equilibrium in which honest participation remains the dominant strategy amidst diverse interactions.
